title: Fairy Ring + Root Disease, Back 9 Greens, Nursery + Himalayan
sheet_name: 5800 600L/Ha - Fairy Ring + Root Disease to Greens (20 Oct)
last_load: Fairy Ring + Root Disease, Front 9 Greens, Mon 19 Oct (same mix)
site_check: Spray signs out on the back nine greens, nursery and Himalayan
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind 3–20 km/h · gusts under 30
extra_checks: Catch test: the boom puts out 600 L/ha at 3 bar and 7.8 km/h
Well under? Stop and call Andy before you fill
No GPS on the 5800: box out each green, then fill in
Surrounds don't need spraying. Every part of the green does
Watering in lined up behind the sprayer
About 6 mm on each green (3 mm, soak, 3 mm), starting within 1 h

products.note: Goes in 3rd, before the Zeemil and the wetting agent (sheet has it last).

ppe_note: Terreplex and Zeemil irritate eyes and skin, and Zeemil gives off solvent vapour, so mix in the full kit.
spray_rules: No GPS on this sprayer: box out each green (a lap round the edge), then fill in. Surrounds don't need it, but every part of the green does
Get on at first light. Gusts are 30 km/h by 6am and 34 by 9am: stop if it's blowing off target, and aim to be off by 9
Water in about 6 mm behind each green (3 mm, soak, 3 mm), starting within 1 h. Don't let it dry on the leaf
Back nine is clear of golf until about 9:00. Keep people off each green until it's watered in
spray_more: Evolution Advance label: wind 3–20 km/h, medium droplets or coarser, no spraying in an inversion, don't apply if rain is expected within 48 h (none forecast today). Zeemil label: beware of solvent vapours near the open tank.
post_checks: Every green watered in, about 6 mm (3 + 3), within 1 h of spraying
Soil pass: it must not dry on the leaf

flags.t: Zeemil 2.0 L/ha: at its label max, off-label on turf
flags.d: Zeemil 250 EC (metalaxyl 250 g/L) is registered for pineapples only, at 2 L/ha every 4 to 8 weeks. On greens it's off-label; Victoria allows that at or below the label rate and interval. The front nine had it yesterday; this tank is the back nine, nursery and Himalayan, so each green gets it once. It's the only Pythium root rot product in this tank.
flags.s: APVMA 49822 eLabel · Turf Data reference notes

flags.d: Blue AIC (03) at 3 bar is about 1.2 L/min a nozzle. On the 5800's 50 cm spacing at 7.8 km/h that's about 180 L/ha if they're TeeJet 03s, not 600. 600 L/ha at 3 bar: white AIC (08) at about 6.2 km/h, or grey (06) at about 4.7 km/h. The catch test on the sprayer check settles it.
flags.s: TeeJet AIC flow at 4 bar · 50 cm nozzle spacing

flags.t: Evolution Advance 2.2 L/ha is the label high rate
flags.d: Fairy ring 1.6–2.2 L/ha. Label: low rate from late October to early November, high rate if symptoms are present, reapply after 30 days if needed. Max 2 consecutive sprays, 3 per season.

flags.t: Wind: gusts over 30 from first light
flags.d: This morning's brief: N 15 km/h at dawn rising to 21 by 11am, gusts 30 by 6am, 34 by 9am and 37 at 11am. Evolution Advance's label wind range is 3–20 km/h. Get on at first light, spray the lulls and stop if it's blowing off target. Rain is nil today, so the 48 h rain restraint is clear.

flags.t: Wash in straight away: 600 L/ha is under label volume
flags.d: The label's root-disease use is about 1000 L/ha with 6–10 mm of irrigation within 1 hour; the sheet asks for about 6 mm. Cirrus group #24 back nine programs are set to about 3 mm a pass (per head, from Sunday's TurfRad scan), so run each hole twice with a soak between. Not in those programs: the 10th (only 10G2), the 17th (only 17G2), 12G3, 12G4, 12G6, 14G1, 14G2 and 18G5, plus the nursery and Himalayan. Those need manual runs or the hose.

flags.t: Fungicide + wetting agent on bentgrass in the heat
flags.d: Tebuconazole plus HydroForce, 28 °C by afternoon, six days after Shadow Ultra and Promote Plus. Envu's guidance is to keep wetting agents two weeks clear of DMI fungicides. Spraying early and watering in straight behind keeps it off the leaf.

flags.t: No leaf cover from this pass
flags.d: Evolution Advance's dollar spot, brown patch and anthracnose claims are leaf and crown uses (350–500 L/ha, left on the leaf). Watered in, this is a root-zone pass, so don't count it against the 22–24 Oct leaf-disease spike.
Evolution Advance moves from last to 3rd so the suspension goes in before the EC (Zeemil) and the wetting agent. HydroForce goes in last. Companion and Terreplex condition the water first.
